svg.title: What the hub firewall lets through
svg.desc: rt-spoke1 sends vm-spoke1's internet traffic and its traffic for spoke 2 to afw-hub. The firewall's policy fwp-hub inherits fwp-base's network rules, which allow TCP 22 and ping between the spokes, and adds application rules allowing *.ubuntu.com and www.microsoft.com on HTTP and HTTPS. Anything no rule allows, such as example.com or port 80 between the spokes, is denied.
